name: Rekta Letu
source:
Rekta Letu is the warrior of Majapahit, a great kingdom in east Java. 

His life as a proud warrior changed when he met two Chinese warriors: Luo Xixian and his fiance, Mei Xin.
They ran from Khubilai Khan, taking with them the legendary sword, Nagapuspa. Whoever had the sword would be able to gain unlimited power. However, the trio failed to realize that the sword was also a curse, for it drained its holder's chi. Luo died protecting the sword and Mei Xin continued her life with Rekta, the two falling in love over time. Eventually they married and lived peacefully, away from world's conflicts. 

But their happiness didn't last long. One day, Rekta's older brother, Arya Dwipangga, arrived, kidnapping Mei Xin and later attempting to rape her. Burning with anger, Rekta used the Sword of Nagapuspa to slay Dwipangga, saving his wife from his brother. A year later, Mei Xin heard that the king of Majapahit was sick. She asked Rekta to accompany her to Majapahit in order to help cure the King, to which Rekta agreed. But in the midst of their journey, they were ambushed by a mysterious person who was able to defeat Rekta, kidnapping Mei Xin in the process.

Frustrated by his own weakness, Rekta began training to increase his strength. During this time, he met a British man named Arthur Pendragon, who made a deal with him: if Rekta joined his new fellowship, The Knights of the Round Table, and helped defeat Arthur's enemy, Morgana, Arthur would help Rekta find his missing wife.
